items.title: Michael Weiss interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 22, 2021
items.q: once I was in New York I began subbing on the Vanguard Jazz Orchestra, first with Mel and then after Mel.

ctx.x: Yeah. We just played “Groove Merchant” here about ten days ago, from Thad’s book.

Sure. Well everything kind of came full circle because once I was in New York I began subbing on the Vanguard Jazz Orchestra, first with Mel and then after Mel. And then, even though I wasn’t an official member of the band I probably played more gigs as the pianist of the band than any other pianist in the history of the — I think I played over 700 gigs with the band, or 600, something crazy. But all to say that as a professional musician I was able to sit inside the band night after night and Thad’s genius just…

I was going to save this question for later but you’re talking about early on learning how to voice horns. I wonder if that experience translated to the way you comp at the piano? That your hands may be recreating or have in mind how you voice those horns?
